claim.quote: Under standard halo assumptions, these data partially exclude parameter space favored by interpretations of the DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT experiments' data as WIMP signals, and exclude new parameter space for WIMP masses between 3 GeV/c^2 and 4 GeV/c^2.

name: Low-threshold analysis of CDMS shallow-site data
notes: Attributed to experiment:cdms-ii (the data are from the first tower of CDMS II ZIP detectors) but taken at the Stanford Underground Facility, not at Soudan where the Atlas places CDMS II.

summary.plain: Old data from the first tower of CDMS II detectors, taken at the shallow Stanford tunnel in 2001-02, were re-analysed down to about 1 keV and partly ruled out the light dark matter regions suggested by DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT.
summary.technical: Four ~224 g Ge and two ~105 g Si ZIP detectors at the Stanford Underground Facility, December 2001 - June 2002 (118 live days raw); low-threshold analysis down to the ~1 keV (Ge) and ~2 keV (Si) trigger thresholds; limits for WIMP masses below 9 GeV/c^2.

title: Low-threshold analysis of CDMS shallow-site data
why_it_matters: One of the first low-threshold germanium results to test the CoGeNT and DAMA/LIBRA light-WIMP interpretations.
